## Addition checklist

- [ ] It is about AI + Laravel (general Laravel packages belong on awesome-laravel lists instead).
- [ ] One line, neutral tone: `- [name](link) - What it does, plainly stated.`
- [ ] The link loads (lychee also checks it in CI).
- [ ] No duplicates — I searched the list first.
- [ ] Placed in the right section, keeping rough alphabetical order by name.
